page.notes: The scan is slightly cropped at the right edge; the marginal notes on the right are not legible. Some words in the Latin italic lines are doubtful, notably "setestem" (probably "testem") and "Ea propter inter missarum solennia"; these are marked as best reading. The final word "ftitisset" is partly cut off at the foot and is read as "stitisset" (praestitisset).
